notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
The player can spend a multiple of 30 Lottery Coins (max. 3000 at a time) to obtain one random reward for each 30 Lottery Coins spent.
